name: orb_momentum_v22
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's first 20 minutes (09:15-09:35) is the overnight information absorption window — FII/DII desks reconcile gap risk, news flow, and SGX Nifty signals before committing directional capital. Large institutional participants use this range to calibrate their day's TWAP/VWAP benchmarks and avoid entering until the range stabilizes. When price closes above the ORB high with VWAP confirmation, it signals that buy-side institutional flow has overwhelmed the supply ceiling created during the opening range; the executing algo is only partially filled and must continue buying, producing 20-40 spot point continuation moves. A 3-bar (15-second) persistence filter at 5s resolution eliminates the frequent spike-and-retrace noise inherent in index microstructure that would never occur in the original 1-minute framing.

indicators.name: orb_high
indicators.purpose: Fixed 20-minute time window (09:15-09:35 = 240 bars at 5s). NOT scaled from original — the opening range is the same 20-minute real-time window regardless of bar granularity. The window size is defined by market structure (when institutional participants settle into directional flow), not by a rolling lookback.

indicators.name: orb_low
indicators.purpose: Mirror of orb_high for bearish breakdowns. Same fixed 20-minute window rationale.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset per day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure — no lookback scaling needed. Used as trend context filter: ORB breakout above VWAP confirms institutional net buying for the session. Below VWAP breakout on upside would be suspect (supply overhang).

indicators.name: persist_3bar
indicators.purpose: New indicator absent in original — required at 5s because index microstructure produces frequent 1-bar transient spikes above/below range that reverse immediately. 15-second persistence (3 bars) is the minimum confirmation that the breakout is real. Original 1-minute bars naturally filtered these sub-minute spikes.

indicators.name: vol_ratio
indicators.purpose: 10-minute rolling average volume ratio adapted from original's SMA(volume, 20) on 1-min bars (= 20 minutes). Compressed to 120 bars (10 min) because at 5s resolution we want a recent, session-aware baseline. Confirms breakout is accompanied by above-average activity, not a thin-market spike.

buy_ce.confirmation: 3-bar persistence above ORB high + VWAP confirmation

buy_pe.confirmation: 3-bar persistence below ORB low + VWAP confirmation

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. ORB breakouts typically 'throwback' to test the breakout level before continuation — a 10 spot point throwback is within normal range and doesn't invalidate the thesis. Beyond 10 pts, the breakout has likely failed and reversed.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points = ~16 NIFTY spot points. The first leg of a genuine ORB breakout on NIFTY extends 20-40 spot points beyond the range boundary; 16 pts captures the lower half of this distribution conservatively. Risk:reward = 1:1.6.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 14:30 IST — late-day ORB chasing degrades as liquidity thins and range expansion stalls

filters.vix_filter: none — ORB works in both high and low VIX; edge decays only at extremes (VIX < 10 or VIX > 35), not modeled
filters.time_filter: 09:35-14:30 IST only; skip first 20 min to let range form, cut off at 14:30 to avoid late-session low-volume fakeouts
filters.volume_filter: volume > 1.2x rolling 10-min average as breakout confirmation
filters.trend_filter: VWAP — price must be on the correct side of VWAP for the breakout direction
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — behavioral. ORB edge decays as more algos exploit it; remains durable when combined with VWAP/volume confirmation that filters mechanical ORB systems.

adaptation_notes: Original trades a universe of Nifty200 stocks on 1-min bars, holding 10-30 minutes. Conversion keeps the core ORB thesis unchanged (opening range as institutional calibration window) but adapts the execution: (1) Applied to NIFTY index, not individual stocks — indices show cleaner ORBs because they aggregate order flow across all participants simultaneously. (2) Opening range remains 20 real-time minutes (240 bars vs original's 20 bars — same wall-clock time). (3) Added 3-bar persistence filter that is MANDATORY at 5s but irrelevant at 1-min. (4) ATR-based stops replaced by fixed option premium points (5 pts stop, 8 pts target) calibrated to NIFTY's typical 20-40 spot point ORB continuation. (5) Volume filter adapted from SMA(volume,20) on 1-min to rolling 120-bar (10-min) mean on 5s bars — same conceptual purpose, same real-time window. (6) Session end cutoff added at 14:30 IST — original's 15:15 cutoff is appropriate for 10-30 min holds but we exit by 14:30 to avoid low-volume late-session conditions incompatible with 30-120 second holds.
weaknesses: High frequency of false breakouts on NIFTY at 5s — partially mitigated by 3-bar persistence but not eliminated
3-bar filter introduces 15-second entry lag; miss ~15 pts of move on fast breakout days
Only 1-3 valid ORB breakouts per day on NIFTY — low trade frequency requires patience
Opening range can be distorted by SGX Nifty overnight gap reversals, creating failed ORBs
Strategy has no edge after 14:30 — ORB continuation typically exhausted by early afternoon
